analyst.summary: Balu Forge is successfully diversifying its forgings business into defence, aerospace and railways, which now make up about half its order book, including new NATO supply-chain and artillery-shell orders. However, the company's own auditors flagged a large amount of export receivables (about 339 crore, roughly 30% of a year's revenue) as outstanding, including some that have breached Reserve Bank of India-prescribed collection timelines, alongside a separate pool of uncashed cheques - a genuine cash-collection concern that sits awkwardly next to a weak fourth quarter (revenue and margins actually declined) beneath the strong full-year growth headline. We are flagging this combination for the portfolio manager's attention rather than treating it as routine.
